title: Stakeholders engagement in noise action planning mediated by OGITO – an Open Geospatial Interactive TOol (Suplementary Data)

contacts.name: M Th  Koelen
contacts.affiliation: Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation

descriptions: This supplementary data support the article “Stakeholder engagement in noise action planning mediated by OGITO – an Open Geospatial Interactive TOol” that has been recently accepted for publication in the Journal of Urban Technology (https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/cjut20). The data consist of three appendices as follows: - Appendix A - List of user stories and associated tasks for a Noise Action Planning (NAP) workshop. User stories were collected during an online workshop with professional participants. - Appendix C - Glossary. List of technical terms used in the manuscript associated. It facilitates understanding the full article. - Appendix D - Short description of German terms used in the tool. The tool described in the manuscript presents a list of German terms that non- german speakers might find difficult to understand. This appendix briefly describes those terms.
